name: Shopping bag
description: A thin plastic carrier bag with two loop handles, for bringing shopping home.
notes: Rides on batch 010's `bag_plastic` model, the same two-handled carrier bag standing open; no row of its own. Its mass is 2 g. It is carried in the hand, not worn, so it has no wearable block; Deadvox has no carried-bag slot, and the reference's arm and hand encumbrance is the cost of hauling it.

name: Handbag
description: A stiff leather handbag with a front flap, a gold clasp and two rolled handles.
notes: Standing on its gold feet, 280 mm across the base, 190 mm tall and 100 mm deep, flap and clasp on the front. CHECK VOLUME (x8.4): the reference volume is the inside of the bag, the box includes the handles above it. It hangs from one shoulder, so it takes a new `shoulder_bag` slot: `back` would stop it being worn with a backpack, and `waist` is the belt. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Rope loop
description: A length of rope tied into a loop with a sliding knot, for slinging a bundle of large things over the shoulder. Slow to untie.
notes: Three turns of 12 mm cotton rope about 460 mm across, lying flat, with the sliding knot and its loose tail toward the front. CHECK VOLUME (x36): the reference volume is the rope alone; the box is the open loop. The bundle pocket is slow to reach because the knot must be worked loose; a knot pulled undone in a fight needs a rule Deadvox does not have. A crafted item, so it has no loot economy. It hangs from one shoulder, so it takes a new `shoulder_bag` slot: `back` would stop it being worn with a backpack, and `waist` is the belt. name: Military rucksack
description: A big olive military pack with a strapped lid, a front pocket under webbing, two side pockets, a padded harness and a hip belt.
notes: Standing, front on +z: lid with two buckled straps, a front pocket carrying three webbing rows, side pockets with compression straps, and shoulder straps, back pad and hip belt behind. CHECK VOLUME (x14): the reference volume is the empty pack packed down; the model is the pack standing full at its real size. It is a host: `front_webbing` is the webbing rows on the front pocket, and `side_left` and `side_right` are the compression straps over each side pocket, all slow to reach on the back. Worn on the back, the `back` slot. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Running pack
description: A slim, light blue pack for runners, with a stretch mesh pocket, reflective strips and wide vest straps that keep it from bouncing.
notes: Standing, front on +z: a rounded slim pack 240 mm wide, 420 mm tall and 80 mm deep, a mesh pocket and a crossed bungee on the front, reflective strips at the sides, and vest straps with a chest strap and a bottle pocket behind. CHECK VOLUME (x8.3): the reference volume is the empty pack folded. The mesh draws opaque in the tiles and stays see-through in the game. The strap bottle pocket is quick to reach when worn. Worn on the back, the `back` slot. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Sling pack
description: A teardrop pack on a single padded strap, swung round to the front to reach into it. Holds less than a backpack.
notes: Standing, front on +z: a black teardrop 240 mm wide, 420 mm tall and 120 mm deep with a zipped charcoal front pocket and a grab handle, its padded strap arching from the top to the lower corner behind. CHECK VOLUME (x13): the strap's arch adds air, and the reference volume is the empty pack folded. Its pockets are quicker to reach than a backpack's because it swings round to the chest. Worn across the back, the `back` slot. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.
